title: What's New: Server and Database - New Reporting Capabilities (2023 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Excel Power Query and Power Pivot Integration
Teaching Tips and Help Links for Reports and Queries
Analytics Strategy and Query Design Approach

features.name: Data Analysis on Queries
features.description: The query object now has an analysis view attached and can be opened directly in the UI with Run object support, allowing users to add it as an action on pages to show query results with grouping and pivoting capabilities.

features.name: Server-Side Analysis Views on Queries
features.description: Large amounts of data can now be handled through drill-down queries that work at the server level, allowing users to sum millions of records and drill down using server-side analysis views on queries.
caveats: requires understanding of server-side query execution

features.name: Excel Layout Multiple Data Sheets
features.description: Excel layouts can now handle parent-child or overview-detail types by generating multiple root data items into separate sheets instead of creating a single square data set, providing a more condensed view for Excel modeling.
caveats: only applies to reports targeting Excel layout type

features.name: Excel Power Query and Power Pivot Support
features.description: Excel layouts now support Power Query for data transformation and Power Pivot for modeling relationships between tables, enabling users to create compelling data models and analytics within Excel.
caveats: users may need to learn Excel modeling techniques

features.name: Teaching Tips on Reports and Queries
features.description: Teaching tips are now available on both report and query request pages to help users understand the intent and usage of these features with visual hints that can be dismissed and recalled by hovering over titles.

features.name: Help Links for Reports and Queries
features.description: Context-sensitive help links are now available for reports and queries, allowing developers to create dedicated help documentation that appears on request pages and in the help pane.

features.name: Data Analysis Feature on Lists and Queries
features.description: A data analysis feature is now generally available on both lists and queries, enabling users to perform dynamic query capabilities and filtering for business intelligence purposes.
features.status_evidence_quote: this feature that is now generally available on lists and queries
